zh: 首页焕新：底部导航改为悬浮胶囊，标签顺序重排，切换更顺手
界面整体风格升级，弹窗、浮层与卡片列表观感更统一
Product Hunt 产品支持多图，图片可左右滑动浏览
en: Refreshed home screen: floating pill navigation bar with reordered tabs
Refreshed visual style across the app — dialogs, sheets and card lists now feel consistent
Product Hunt items now show multiple images you can swipe through
